fields.Name: T133 - Action Explorer Search and Narrowed Empty State
fields.Description: Debounced client-side search over the bespoke explorer list plus the distinct IsListNarrowed empty-state branch (no-results variant with Reset-filters CTA) — separate from grid quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Type a search term into the Explorer's 'Search actions...' box in the toolbar and verify the action list RESPONDS — it narrows to name/description matches. Then type a clearly nonsensical term like 'zzzznotanaction' and verify the narrowed empty-state renders with a 'No actions match your filters' message and a 'Reset filters' action. Clear/reset and confirm the list repopulates. The search narrowing and the narrowed empty-state are both success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the 'Search actions...' box narrows the action list to matches
A nonsense search term shows a 'no actions match' empty-state with a reset/clear affordance (not a crash or blank area)
Clearing the search (or clicking Reset) restores the list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
